title: lecole-42-___
intro: Project master for the 42 coursework (private). `repos.json` lists the ten lecole-42* repos (a subset of _git-repos-master/0_registry/repos.json); `./clone.sh --all` clones them into `~/cloud-shared-store/git` and the committed symlinks here point at them. `./check-repos-sot.sh` checks the list against the registry.
